items.title: Lease ends (landlord's ordinary termination)
items.quote: Wegen der langen Mietdauer endet er erst am 31.08.2027.
items.computation: The letter states the exact calendar date on which the ordinary (statutory-notice) termination takes effect because of the long tenancy duration: 31.08.2027. This is a date printed in the letter, not a period to be counted, so it is used as written.

items.title: Deadline for tenant's objection (Widerspruch) under §§ 574-574b BGB to reach landlord
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens am 30.06.2027 zugehen.
items.computation: The letter gives an explicit calendar date by which the tenant's hardship objection under §§ 574–574b BGB must reach (zugehen) the landlord: 30.06.2027. This is a stated date, not a period computed from delivery, so it is used as written. 30 June 2027 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in any German Land, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
